name: 6AN PTFE Braided Black Nylon Hose / Line (E85 + Race Fuel Safe) - BY THE FOOT
title: 6AN PTFE Braided Black Nylon Hose / Line (E85 + Race Fuel Safe) - BY THE FOOT
description:
The 6AN PTFE Braided Black Nylon Hose / Line (E85 + Race Fuel Safe) - BY THE FOOT is a high-performance component engineered for demanding automotive applications. ColorFittings Black Nylon PTFE Hose is engineered for high-pressure, high-temperature fluid transfer in fuel, oil, coolant, brake, and power steering systems. Featuring a smooth-bore PTFE inner liner with a tightly woven black nylon braid, this hose delivers zero permeation, excellent chemical resistance, and consistent flow under extreme conditions.

Designed for racing, street performance, and marine applications, this PTFE hose is compatible with E85, ethanol-based fuels, race fuels, and aggressive fluids that degrade traditional rubber hose. The black nylon braid provides superior abrasion resistance and structural integrity while maintaining flexibility for clean, precise routing.

This hose is designed to be used as part of the ColorFittings system. For a proper seal and reliable performance, pair it with their PTFE Hose Ends, precision-machined to match the PTFE liner and nylon braid. Use Hose Separators to organize multi-line installations and prevent abrasion, and complete assembly with their Hose Assembly Tools to ensure correct alignment, prevent damage, and achieve professional results.

Technical Specifications:
• Construction: Precision machined for rigorous track and street applications.
